requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall develop, maintain, and execute a Software Development Plan and a Software Security Plan covering the full software life cycle from requirements through retirement, addressing every applicable requirement of NPR 7150.2D per the approved Requirements Mapping Matrix.
gold_rationale: Requires development, maintenance, and execution of life-cycle software and security plans addressing applicable NPR obligations through the approved mapping matrix.
agent_reasoning: SWE-013 mandates development and execution of software plans covering the full life cycle and addressing NPR 7150.2D requirements with approved tailoring. SWE-125 requires a requirements mapping matrix to align with NPR requirements. The proposed requirement satisfies both by explicitly stating development, maintenance, execution of software and security plans, and reference to the approved mapping matrix.

requirement_text: The NASA software shall meet performance expectations as determined by the development team prior to delivery.
gold_rationale: Performance expectations do not require the project manager to define and document software acceptance criteria.
agent_reasoning: The proposed requirement states performance expectations are determined by the development team, but NASA requires the project manager to monitor and ensure performance meets or exceeds requirements, including constraints. The requirement lacks accountability to the project manager and omits verification against defined performance and functionality requirements. SWE-199 and SWE-055 mandate performance validation and monitoring, which are not addressed.

requirement_text: For Class B software, the NASA Project Manager shall perform, record, and maintain bidirectional traceability between higher-level and software requirements, software requirements and system hazards, software requirements and design components, design components and code, software requirements and software verifications, and software requirements and software non-conformances. The traceability records shall be updated within five business days of a requirement change.
gold_rationale: Covers every Class B relationship in Table 1, including hazards and non-conformances.
agent_reasoning: SWE-052 mandates bidirectional traceability for Class B software across all specified pairs: higher-level to software requirements, software to hazards, design components, code, verification, and non-conformances. The requirement explicitly includes these traceability links and specifies update within five business days of change, aligning with SWE-053 on change tracking. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall establish, capture, record, approve, and maintain software requirements, including requirements for the reused GPS ephemeris library, in the DOORS requirements repository as part of the project technical specification.
gold_rationale: Requires every listed requirements-management action and makes the technical-specification role explicit.
agent_reasoning: SWE-050 mandates the project manager to establish, capture, record, approve, and maintain software requirements, including those for reused components, as part of the technical specification. The proposed requirement aligns fully with this obligation, specifically covering reused GPS ephemeris library requirements in the DOORS repository.

requirement_text: Changes to NASA software requirements shall be logged in the issue tracker by the engineer making the change.
gold_gap_type: Missing obligation to manage requirement changes
gold_rationale: Logging requirement changes provides recording and tracking, but no obligation to manage them. The cited clause does not itself mandate a CCB or a particular approval procedure.
agent_reasoning: NASA SWE-053 mandates the project manager to track and manage changes, not the engineer. The proposed requirement shifts responsibility to the engineer, which contradicts the obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall perform requirements validation with the customer, including scenario-based walkthroughs and a requirements review board, to confirm the software will perform as intended in the lunar relay operational environment prior to baselining.
gold_rationale: Requires requirements validation demonstrating intended behavior in the customer operational environment.
agent_reasoning: SWE-055 mandates requirements validation to ensure software performs as intended in the customer environment; the proposed requirement aligns by specifying validation with the customer and scenario-based walkthroughs in the lunar relay environment, which is a specific instance of the customer environment. No mandatory obligations are missed or contradicted.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall transform the approved software requirements into a recorded software architecture, documented in the Software Architecture Description Document (SADD) and baselined under configuration management prior to detailed design.
gold_rationale: Requires transformation of software requirements into a recorded architecture.
agent_reasoning: SWE-057 mandates the project manager to transform software requirements into a recorded software architecture, which is directly covered by the proposed requirement. The mention of baselining under configuration management aligns with SWE-081 and SWE-083, which require identification and status recording of configuration items. No mandatory obligations are missing or contradicted.

requirement_text: NASA software developers shall write clean, maintainable code following good engineering judgment.
gold_rationale: Clean code and engineering judgment do not select, define, or commit adherence to software coding methods, standards, and criteria.
agent_reasoning: SWE-061 mandates project managers to define and adhere to coding methods, standards, and criteria, which includes clean and maintainable code. The proposed requirement lacks specificity on how 'good engineering judgment' is defined or enforced, missing explicit adherence to formal standards. Thus, it partially meets the obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall use static analysis tools during development and testing to analyze code for defects, software security, code coverage, and software complexity, and shall track identified findings to closure in the defect tracking system.
gold_rationale: Includes both phases and all four minimum analysis purposes in the clause.
agent_reasoning: SWE-135 mandates static analysis for defects, security, coverage, and complexity during development and testing. The requirement covers these elements and includes tracking findings to closure, aligned with SWE-201 on tracking non-conformances. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall unit test each software code unit against its detailed design prior to integration, and shall record unit test results in the test management system.
gold_rationale: Requires software code unit testing; recorded results and timing add detail beyond SWE-062.
agent_reasoning: SWE-062 mandates unit testing by the project manager, SWE-068 requires recording test evaluation, and the proposed requirement aligns with both by specifying unit testing against detailed design and recording results in the test management system. No mandatory obligations are missing or contradicted.

requirement_text: NASA unit tests shall be executed by the responsible developer during code review.
gold_rationale: Requires test execution but supplies no repeatability assurance. SWE-186 does not require automation specifically, so the rationale should focus on missing repeatability rather than missing automation.
agent_reasoning: NASA requires the project manager to perform unit testing, not the responsible developer during code review. The proposed requirement shifts responsibility incorrectly and omits mandatory project manager oversight. [SWE-062]

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall test the flight and ground software against its baselined software requirements, using documented test procedures and pass/fail criteria traceable to each requirement.
gold_rationale: Requires software testing against requirements.
agent_reasoning: SWE-066 mandates testing against software requirements, which is covered. However, the proposed requirement specifies testing against 'baselined' requirements and includes 'pass/fail criteria traceable to each requirement', which is not explicitly required in SWE-066 or SWE-192. SWE-192 requires verification for hazardous events, but does not mandate traceability of pass/fail criteria. Thus, traceability is missing.

requirement_text: NASA software items may be placed under configuration management once qualification testing has demonstrated stable behavior.
gold_gap_type: CM baseline established after testing, not before
gold_rationale: Makes configuration management optional after qualification testing without requiring placement before testing.
agent_reasoning: NASA SWE-187 mandates configuration management prior to testing, not after qualification testing. The proposed requirement contradicts this by placing CM post-testing, which is not allowed. SWE-187 is the most directly relevant clause.

requirement_text: For safety-critical NASA flight software components, the Project Manager shall achieve high structural test coverage as demonstrated by the test team.
gold_gap_type: Coverage target not quantified to the required standard
gold_rationale: Positively requires structural test coverage for safety-critical components but omits 100 percent and MC/DC. The source note allows deviations through technical authority review and waiver; it does not make an unspecified alternate standard automatically sufficient.
agent_reasoning: SWE-219 mandates 100% MC/DC coverage for safety-critical components, not just high test coverage. The proposed requirement fails to specify MC/DC or any formal coverage criterion, missing a core obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall verify through test every software requirement that traces to a hazardous event, hazard cause, or hazard mitigation technique in the NASA Hazard Analysis, and shall record the verification evidence in the Verification Compliance Matrix.
gold_rationale: Includes hazardous events, causes, and mitigation techniques, with verification through test.
agent_reasoning: The requirement aligns with SWE-192 by mandating test verification of software requirements tracing to hazardous events, causes, or mitigation techniques, and includes recording evidence in the Verification Compliance Matrix, which is consistent with the clause's obligation to verify and document traceability.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall perform a software cybersecurity assessment of all flight and ground software components under Agency security policies and project cybersecurity requirements, including risks posed by COTS, GOTS, MOTS, open-source, and reused software components, before Critical Design Review.
gold_rationale: Includes Agency policy, project requirements, and risks from third-party or reused software.
agent_reasoning: SWE-156 mandates a software cybersecurity assessment by the project manager, including risks from COTS, GOTS, MOTS, OSS, and reused components, before Critical Design Review. The proposed requirement matches this exactly in scope and timing. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall test the software cybersecurity mitigations identified in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.
gold_rationale: Requires testing of cybersecurity mitigations but omits recorded results and does not establish vulnerability/weakness-analysis provenance of the register.
agent_reasoning: SWE-159 mandates the project manager to test software cybersecurity mitigations identified from security vulnerabilities and weaknesses analysis, which aligns with the proposed requirement. The requirement specifies testing of mitigations from the Cybersecurity Risk Register, consistent with SWE-159's obligation. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall identify, record, and implement secure coding practices (e.g., input validation, least privilege, secure error handling) in the Secure Coding Standard, and shall verify adherence during code review.
gold_rationale: Requires identification, recording, and implementation of secure coding practices.
agent_reasoning: SWE-207 mandates identification, recording, and implementation of secure coding practices, which is covered. However, SWE-185 requires verification via static analysis tools, not just code review, creating a gap in verification method. The proposed requirement omits tool-based verification.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall develop a Software Configuration Management Plan describing the functions, responsibilities, and authority for configuration management activities across the software life cycle, including the composition and authority of the Configuration Control Board.
gold_rationale: Requires a CM plan describing functions, responsibilities, and authority.
agent_reasoning: The proposed requirement aligns with SWE-079 by specifying that the project manager develops a software configuration management plan covering functions, responsibilities, and authority, including the Configuration Control Board. This fully satisfies the mandatory obligation in SWE-079.

requirement_text: The NASA Configuration Control Board may perform software configuration audits at its discretion.
gold_gap_type: Audits are optional rather than performed
gold_rationale: Discretionary audits do not impose the mandatory configuration-audit activity or its required checks.
agent_reasoning: SWE-084 mandates the project manager to perform software configuration audits, not the NASA Configuration Control Board. The proposed requirement shifts responsibility to the NASA Configuration Control Board and lacks the mandatory project manager role. This contradicts the obligation in SWE-084.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall perform and report software peer reviews or inspections for software requirements; software plans, including cybersecurity plans; design items identified for review in the software development plans; software code defined for review in the software or project plans; and software test procedures. Findings shall be recorded in the peer review log.
gold_rationale: Covers all five artifact categories in items a through e, with both performance and reporting.
agent_reasoning: SWE-087 mandates the project manager to perform and report peer reviews for software requirements, plans (including cybersecurity), design items, code, and test procedures, matching the proposed requirement exactly. The requirement also specifies recording findings in a peer review log, aligned with SWE-089's obligation to record necessary measurements. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: NASA software management and technical measurements shall be collected by each subsystem lead and stored in a shared spreadsheet.
gold_gap_type: No reporting, maintenance, or utilization of measurements
gold_rationale: Collection and spreadsheet storage cover some measurement activity, but no obligation to maintain, report, or utilize the measurements is present.
agent_reasoning: SWE-090 mandates the project manager to establish, record, maintain, report, and utilize software management and technical measurements, not subsystem leads using a shared spreadsheet. The proposed requirement shifts responsibility to subsystem leads and uses a spreadsheet, which is not specified or authorized in NASA NPR 7150.2D.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall track and maintain all software non-conformances, including defects found in ground support tools and reused software components, in the Non-Conformance Tracking System through closure.
gold_rationale: Requires tracking and maintaining all software nonconformances through closure; ground support tools are explicitly included.
agent_reasoning: SWE-201 mandates the project manager to track and maintain software non-conformances, including defects in tools and ground software. The proposed requirement aligns directly with this obligation by specifying tracking in the Non-Conformance Tracking System through closure. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: NASA software non-conformances shall be assigned by the reporting engineer to severity level 'important' or 'not important'.
gold_rationale: Implements categories but leaves their severity criteria undefined; the clause requires clear levels.
agent_reasoning: SWE-202 mandates the project manager to define and implement software severity levels for all non-conformances, not just assign them to 'important' or 'not important'. The proposed requirement fails to specify that severity levels must be defined and implemented by the project manager, only assigning levels. This omits the core obligation of defining levels, creating a gap.

requirement_text: Before acquiring or using the reused GPS ephemeris library or COTS RTOS, the NASA Project Manager shall identify the requirements each component must meet; obtain documentation sufficient for its intended purpose; address rights, licenses, ownership, warranty, transfer, and conditions of use with Center Intellectual Property Counsel; plan adequate future support; verify and validate each component to the same level as comparable developed software; and plan periodic assessments of vendor-reported defects for project impact.
gold_rationale: Explicitly covers all six conditions without naming the expected SWE ID inside the example.
agent_reasoning: SWE-027 mandates identification of requirements, documentation, IP rights coordination, future support planning, verification/validation to developed software level, and defect assessment plans. The proposed requirement covers all these obligations explicitly and without contradiction.

requirement_text: The project manager shall document that the spacecraft navigation software team’s progress will be reviewed and audited at the design-completion and testing-completion milestones.
gold_rationale: Defines documented milestones for developer progress review and audit.
agent_reasoning: SWE-037 mandates that the project manager define and document milestones for software progress reviews and audits. The proposed requirement specifies reviews at design-completion and testing-completion milestones, which aligns with this obligation. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall collect the number of changes to the spacecraft navigation software requirements each month, track those changes in a requirements log, and report the results to the project team at monthly reviews.
gold_rationale: Requires collecting, tracking, and reporting the count of requirement changes, a volatility metric.
agent_reasoning: SWE-200 mandates collection and reporting of software requirements volatility metrics, which includes tracking changes. The proposed requirement specifies monthly collection and reporting of change counts, but does not explicitly address volatility metrics or traceability. SWE-053 and SWE-080 cover change tracking, but lack the monthly reporting detail. Missing metric scope and volatility focus creates a partial coverage gap.

requirement_text: The project manager shall provide NASA with a PDF containing screenshots of the spacecraft navigation software’s source code at project completion.
gold_gap_type: Source code not provided in a modifiable format
gold_rationale: Screenshots do not give NASA electronic source code in a modifiable format.
agent_reasoning: SWE-042 mandates electronic access to source code in a modifiable format, not screenshots. The proposed requirement requests screenshots, which is not aligned with the obligation to provide modifiable source code. This constitutes a gap.

requirement_text: For every high-severity software non-conformance, the NASA Project Manager shall assess the software processes that contributed to the defect and implement a closed-loop corrective-action process that tracks process improvements through resolution.
gold_rationale: Explicitly assesses contributing processes and closes corrective actions for every high-severity case.
agent_reasoning: SWE-204 mandates that the project manager implement process assessments for all high-severity software non-conformances as a closed-loop process. The proposed requirement aligns by specifying assessment of contributing processes and implementation of a closed-loop corrective-action process with tracking of improvements. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall require the spacecraft navigation software developers to provide NASA with software products, requirements traceability, change records, defect reports, and development and management metrics in electronic format.
gold_rationale: Requires electronic software products, traceability, change information, nonconformances, and development/management metrics.
agent_reasoning: SWE-040 mandates the project manager to require software developers to provide software products, traceability, change tracking, nonconformances, and development metrics in electronic format. The proposed requirement covers all these elements, including traceability, change records, defect reports, and metrics, thus fully aligning with the obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall record the spacecraft navigation software’s size and effort estimates, milestones, and project characteristics in the team’s internal planning document at each major milestone.
gold_gap_type: Missing submission to Center measurement repository
gold_rationale: Requires the planning parameters at major milestones but only records them internally, omitting submission to the Center measurement repository.
agent_reasoning: SWE-174 mandates submission to the Center measurement repository, not internal planning documents. The proposed requirement omits submission to NASA's repository and restricts documentation to internal use, creating a gap in compliance with the mandatory reporting obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall require the spacecraft navigation software developers to provide a software development schedule for NASA’s review and submit updated schedules whenever NASA requests them.
gold_rationale: Requires a developer schedule for project review and requested updates.
agent_reasoning: SWE-046 mandates the project manager to require software developers to provide a software schedule for review and update it as requested. The proposed requirement aligns directly with this obligation, including the requirement for submission upon NASA's request. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall hold monthly meetings with project stakeholders to review the spacecraft navigation software’s schedule, development activities, performance metrics, and assessment results.
gold_rationale: Requires regular stakeholder reviews of schedule, activities, metrics, and assessments but omits tracking issues to resolution.
agent_reasoning: SWE-018 mandates regular reviews of schedule, status, performance metrics, and assessment results with stakeholders; the proposed requirement aligns by specifying monthly meetings covering these elements. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall conduct regression testing after changes to the spacecraft navigation software to confirm that previously working features still function correctly.
gold_rationale: Requires regression testing for preserved functionality but omits planning and a demonstration that changes did not introduce security vulnerabilities.
agent_reasoning: SWE-191 mandates regression testing to ensure defects are not introduced into previously integrated software, which aligns with the proposed requirement. The requirement specifies testing after changes to navigation software, consistent with the obligation to verify previously working features. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall plan and track project-specific software training for all project personnel and ensure that each person completes the training needed for their project work.
gold_rationale: Plans, tracks, and ensures project-specific training across the stated project-personnel scope.
agent_reasoning: SWE-017 mandates the project manager to plan, track, and ensure project-specific software training for personnel, which is fully covered by the proposed requirement. No gaps or contradictions exist; the requirement aligns directly with the obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall document the conditions the spacecraft navigation software must meet before NASA accepts it.
gold_rationale: Documenting the conditions for acceptance reasonably entails defining and documenting acceptance criteria.
agent_reasoning: The proposed requirement aligns with NASA SWE-034, which mandates the project manager to define and document acceptance criteria for software. The requirement explicitly states that conditions for spacecraft navigation software must be documented before NASA acceptance, fulfilling the core obligation of SWE-034.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall record problems found in the spacecraft navigation software in a defect log when they are first reported.
gold_gap_type: Missing ongoing maintenance of problem records
gold_rationale: Initial defect logging supplies records but not ongoing tracking and maintenance or explicit applicable tools/ground-software scope.
agent_reasoning: SWE-201 mandates the project manager to track and maintain software non-conformances including defects, which includes recording defects in software when first reported. The proposed requirement is a direct implementation of this obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall define clear severity levels and their assignment criteria, and implement those levels for all software non-conformances in the spacecraft navigation system, including tools, COTS, GOTS, MOTS, open-source and reused components, and applicable ground systems.
gold_rationale: Defines clear criteria and implements levels across every listed applicable component category.
agent_reasoning: SWE-202 mandates the project manager to define and implement clear severity levels for all software non-conformances, including tools, COTS, GOTS, MOTS, OSS, reused components, and ground systems. The proposed requirement fully aligns with this obligation, including scope and intent. No gaps or contradictions exist.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall record and maintain measurements of the mission-planning software’s performance throughout development.
gold_rationale: Requires recording and maintaining technical performance measurements but omits management measurements, establishment, reporting, and use.
agent_reasoning: SWE-090 mandates the project manager to record, maintain, report, and utilize software management and technical measurements. The proposed requirement aligns with this by specifying recording and maintenance of performance measurements during development. No gaps or contradictions exist; the requirement is a direct fulfillment of the obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall audit the ground-system monitoring software to confirm that each software component is the correct version and matches its configuration records.
gold_rationale: Requires configuration audits for correct component versions and conformity to their records.
agent_reasoning: SWE-084 mandates software configuration audits to verify correct versions and conformity to records; the proposed requirement directly aligns with this obligation by auditing versions and configuration records.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall review reported problems in the mission-planning application’s reused software components only when those problems are marked as high severity.
gold_rationale: Explicitly limits assessments of reused-component problems to high severity, contradicting mandatory assessment of all reported nonconformances.
agent_reasoning: SWE-203 mandates mandatory assessments of reported non-conformances for reused software components, requiring the project manager to assess all reported issues, not just high-severity ones. The proposed requirement limits review to high-severity problems, which contradicts the mandatory obligation to assess all reported non-conformances. Thus, it fails to meet the requirement.

requirement_text: When tailoring of an NPR 7150.2D requirement is approved, the NASA Project Manager shall document and reflect that tailored requirement in the plans or procedures controlling development, acquisition, and deployment of the affected flight-control software.
gold_rationale: Identifies approved directive tailoring rather than ordinary software-product changes, and records it in controlling plans or procedures.
agent_reasoning: SWE-121 mandates that the project manager document and reflect tailored requirements in plans or procedures controlling development, acquisition, and deployment. The proposed requirement directly aligns with this obligation without contradiction or omission.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall identify cybersecurity risks in the mission-planning software and list ways to reduce them, but will not create a plan for putting those protections in place.
gold_rationale: Explicitly rejects planning mitigation implementation, a mandatory action, despite identifying risks and mitigations.
agent_reasoning: SWE-154 mandates the project manager to identify cybersecurity risks and plan mitigations, not just list them. The proposed requirement fails to include a plan for implementing protections, which is a direct contradiction to the mandatory obligation in SWE-154.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall test the ground-control software cybersecurity mitigation implementations required by the security vulnerabilities and weaknesses analysis, and shall record the test results.
gold_rationale: Both tests and records results for the required mitigations derived from the specified analysis.
agent_reasoning: The proposed requirement aligns with SWE-159, which mandates the project manager to test software cybersecurity mitigation implementations identified from a security vulnerabilities and weaknesses analysis and to record test results. The text is a direct paraphrase of this obligation without omission or contradiction.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall review the ground-control software’s test results and save a written evaluation of what the results show.
gold_rationale: Requires evaluation of test results and recording the evaluation.
agent_reasoning: SWE-068 mandates the project manager to evaluate test results and record the evaluation; the proposed requirement aligns directly with this obligation.

requirement_text: When flight software requirements change, the NASA Project Manager shall update its test plans, but may retain test procedures even when those procedures are inconsistent with the changed requirements.
gold_gap_type: Procedures may remain inconsistent with changed requirements
gold_rationale: Expressly allows inconsistent procedures, contradicting the required consistency of plans and procedures.
agent_reasoning: SWE-071 mandates that test procedures must be updated to be consistent with software requirements, not retained even if inconsistent. The proposed requirement explicitly allows retaining inconsistent test procedures, which contradicts SWE-071.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall test the mission-planning software on a desktop computer before delivery, without testing it on its intended operating system or a high-fidelity simulation.
gold_gap_type: Missing validation on the target platform or high-fidelity simulation
gold_rationale: Explicitly excludes the targeted operating system and high-fidelity simulation and therefore waives the required target-platform or simulation validation.
agent_reasoning: NASA SWE-073 mandates testing on the targeted platform or high-fidelity simulation, but the proposed requirement excludes testing on the intended operating system or simulation, directly contradicting this obligation.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall identify and record risks affecting the mission communication software, analyze them, and create plans to reduce them, but does not need to track the risks or share the plans with the project team.
gold_rationale: Explicitly waives tracking and communicating risks and plans. Control is also missing. These direct waivers take precedence over the positive recording, analysis, and planning actions.
agent_reasoning: SWE-086 mandates the project manager to track and communicate software risks, but the proposed requirement omits tracking and sharing of risk plans, creating a direct contradiction to 'track, control, and communicate' obligations.

requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall keep a record of changes to the satellite communication software but does not need to evaluate how those changes affect the software.
gold_rationale: Explicitly waives evaluation of software-product changes, despite requiring change records.
agent_reasoning: NASA SWE-080 mandates that the project manager shall track and evaluate changes to software products. The proposed requirement only states tracking without evaluating changes, which contradicts the mandatory evaluation obligation.

requirement_text: Before retiring the mission-planning software, the NASA Project Manager shall identify which records and software tools need to be archived, where they will be stored, and how the team can access them later.
gold_rationale: Requires identification of archive contents, location, and access procedures for retirement.
agent_reasoning: SWE-196 mandates the project manager to identify archived records and tools, specify archive location, and define access procedures for software retirement or disposal. The proposed requirement aligns directly with this obligation, covering all mandatory elements without contradiction.
